article.headline: How to Seat 400 Guests Across Three Ceremonies
article.description: Seating 400 guests across a Mehndi, Sangeet, and Reception is a logistics problem most Western venue software cannot solve. The frameworks, decisions, and repeat mistakes across hundreds of multi-ceremony South Asian, Muslim, and fusion weddings.
